running_thesis: Cboe (23 Nov): Huang's return (NVDA 8-K, 22 Nov) lifted Nvidia about 31.5%, Nasdaq 100 +6.7%, S&P 500 +4.7% to 7,237; VIX 26.62, VXN 36.31, COR1M 25.68. Yields flat (10y 4.92%). Hike on 9 Dec priced (Polymarket 25 bp 93.5%). Headlines (unverified) show a premarket fade on 24 Nov. HY OAS 3.76 on 20 Nov. The Digest sees AI-specific rotation, not macro de-risking. Cboe warns a rebound may be only a reset. Oil data stale to 17 Nov.
open_questions: Does the Nvidia-led rebound hold or fade after the 6.7% day?
Do the SEC-probe and succession questions resurface?
Do credit spreads tighten after the rally?
Do core PCE and GDP on 25 Nov change the 9 Dec hike odds?
